# Iron Workout

> Iron Workout is a paid iOS strength training app (one-time purchase, no subscription) for planning workouts, tracking sets and reps in the gym, and reviewing progress over time. It works fully offline with no account required, no ads, and no analytics. Workout data stays on your device.

Iron Workout is developed by IAMJARL and is available on the Apple App Store for iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760627760. The app focuses on a streamlined gym experience: users create workout programs with exercises, sets, reps, weight targets, and rest timers, then follow them in real time during training.

## Business model

Iron Workout is a paid app with a one-time purchase price on the App Store. There are no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, and no ads. All features are included. Future updates are free.

## Key features

- Workout program builder with exercises, sets, reps, weight targets, rest timers, and supersets
- Real-time workout tracking with haptic rest countdown
- Automatic personal record detection for weight and reps
- Progress charts: volume over time, weekly frequency, estimated 1RM progression, muscle group distribution
- Live Activity on Lock Screen and Dynamic Island during workouts
- Smart dashboard with weekly metrics, workout streak, and training planner
- Apple Health and HealthKit integration (calories burned, heart rate from Apple Watch)
- Per-exercise history with PR tracking and estimated 1RM chart
- CSV export of workout history (sessions, exercises, sets, reps, weights)
- Searchable exercise library and workout history
- 100% offline — no account, no internet, no ads, no analytics (workout data stays on your device; anonymous crash reporting via Sentry for bug fixing)

## Technical details

- Built with SwiftUI and SwiftData (on-device storage)
- iOS 17.0+ required
- WidgetKit home screen widget (streak and weekly stats)
- ActivityKit Live Activity (Lock Screen and Dynamic Island)
- HealthKit integration for workout sessions, calories, and heart rate
- No backend, no cloud, no third-party analytics
